description: Predict.fun markets with each one's 24-hour USD volume, matches and wallets (the 24 whole fill hours ending with the newest hour built, up to ~1.5 h behind the live tape), largest volume first (or newest first). Filter by `status` (open, closed, resolved) and `q` (a substring of the title or question). Returns {markets, next_cursor, as_of_ts}; each market has `market_id` (what the other predictfun tools take), `condition_id`, `title`, `question`, `status`, `trading_status`, `category_slug`, `created_at` (epoch ms).

cursor.description: A previous page's `next_cursor`, unchanged, to read the next page.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring of the title or question.

sort.description: `volume_24h` (default) or `newest`. A cursor works only with its own sort.

status.description: Only markets in this state. Default: all.

name: predictfun_markets
title: Predict.fun Markets
